staff_capabilities.text: Distributed systems, cloud computing, container orchestration, fault tolerance, observability, and resilient network services.
Machine learning, natural language processing, statistical modelling, responsible artificial intelligence, and data science.
Relational databases, data engineering, distributed storage, query optimisation, and large-scale information systems.
Software engineering, requirements analysis, human-computer interaction, accessible web applications, and mobile development.
Computer networks, cybersecurity, intrusion detection, secure protocols, digital forensics, and privacy engineering.
Algorithms, computational complexity, compilers, programming languages, formal methods, and software verification.
